map.到期收益率、当期收益率、持有期收益率等多种计算: Yield to maturity, current yield, holding-period return and more
map.到期收益率(YTM) 使债券未来现金流现值等于价格的贴现率；当期收益率 = 年息: Yield to maturity (YTM) is the discount rate that makes the present value of a bond's future cash flows equal its price; current yield = annual coupon / market price.
map.基于债券定价原理：YTM 为使未来现金流（票息 + 本金）现值等于买入价的贴现率: Based on bond pricing: YTM is the discount rate equating the present value of future cash flows (coupons + principal) to the purchase price; current yield = annual coupon / price; holding-period return also includes capital gains, used to compare bond returns.
map.买入债券并持有至到期的年化收益率: Annualized return from buying a bond and holding it to maturity
map.考虑了利息再投资收益，是最常用的债券收益率指标: Accounts for reinvestment of coupon income; the most widely used bond yield measure
map.债券年利息与当前市场价格的比率: Ratio of a bond's annual interest to its current market price
map.当期收益率 = 年利息 / 当前价格 × 100%: Current yield = annual interest / current price × 100%
map.简单直观，只反映利息收益，不考虑资本利得: Simple and intuitive; reflects only coupon income, ignores capital gains
map.持有债券期间的总收益率: Total return over the bond holding period
map.反映实际投资收益，适用于中途卖出的情况: Reflects actual investment return; suitable for bonds sold before maturity
map.债券价格等于未来现金流的现值之和: Bond price equals the sum of present values of future cash flows
map.长期债券对利率更敏感: Long-term bonds are more sensitive to interest rates
map.国家发行，信用最高，风险最低: Issued by the state; highest credit, lowest risk
map.地方政府发行，用于地方建设: Issued by local governments for local development
map.企业发行，风险高于国债: Issued by enterprises; riskier than government bonds
map.上市公司发行，需核准: Issued by listed companies; subject to approval
map.不付息，折价发行，到期还本: No periodic interest; issued at a discount; principal repaid at maturity
map.无到期日，永久付息: No maturity date; pays interest perpetually
map.利率上升导致债券价格下跌: Rising rates cause bond prices to fall
map.发行人违约，无法还本付息: Issuer default; failure to repay principal and interest
map.无法及时变现: Cannot be sold promptly for cash
map.利息再投资收益下降: Decline in reinvestment income from coupons
map.债券被提前赎回: Bond redeemed early by the issuer
map.衡量债券利率风险，价格对利率的敏感度: Measures interest-rate risk; price sensitivity to rate changes
map.久期的二阶导数，更精确衡量利率风险: Second derivative of duration; more precise rate-risk measure
map.持有到期的年化收益: Annualized return if held to maturity
map.评估违约风险，如AAA、AA、A等: Assesses default risk, e.g. AAA, AA, A, etc.
map.根据风险承受能力选择债券信用等级: Choose bond credit grade by your risk tolerance
map.利率上行期选短债，利率下行期选长债: Favor short-term bonds when rates rise, long-term when rates fall
map.分散投资，降低单一债券违约风险: Diversify to reduce single-issuer default risk
map.关注债券基金，专业管理更省心: Consider bond funds for professional management
map.国债逆回购也是现金管理好工具: Treasury reverse repo is also a good cash-management tool
map.比较不同债券的真实回报: Compare the real returns of different bonds
map.评估买入价与票面利率的关系: Assess the relationship between purchase price and coupon rate
map.当期收益率 = 年息 / 市价。面值 1000、票面利率 5%（年息 50）、市: Current yield = annual coupon / market price. Face 1,000, coupon 5% (annual 50), price 950 → current yield = 50/950 ≈ 5.26%, above the coupon because bought at a discount.
map.到期收益率 YTM 是把未来票息与本金按当前价格贴现、使 NPV=0 的折现率，: YTM is the discount rate that discounts future coupons and principal to the current price so that NPV=0; it accounts for discount/premium and holding period, more comprehensive than current yield.
map.YTM 和票面利率区别？: What is the difference between YTM and coupon rate?
map.票面利率是发行时固定的年息比例；YTM 是考虑当前市价后的实际年化回报。折价买入: Coupon rate is the fixed annual interest set at issuance; YTM is the real annualized return given the current market price. Bought at a discount, YTM > coupon; at a premium, the opposite.
map.债券价格与收益率反向？: Do bond price and yield move in opposite directions?
